address_comment_regular: [Verified] GeometryDecalShaderProperty vtable slot 23 (vtable+0x5C) BuildRenderPasses. In render mode 5 it returns no list; otherwise it caches/clears the property pass list and emits selector 0x188. BSShaderProperty_GetRenderPassName maps 0x188 to BSSM_GEOMDECAL. This is the class's own geometry-decal pass, separate from inherited DECAL_DATA batching (0x18A/0x18B and Lighting30 0x152/0x153). Fallout's corresponding property path emits different selectors 0x1FF/0x1FE; exact feature equivalence remains Unknown.
